## Q&A {.scrollable .smaller}

<!-- Copy this box once per question. Put the question after "Q:" in the title and your answer in the body. -->

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Q: how to work through oral presentations with teams - handing off, moving between slides and splitting up roles in an oral presentation."}
A: Great question! I actually deleted a slide on this for time. There are many ways and I'll suggest two: 1) simply know who you go after and what slide is before when you start to talk. Do it as if one person is givig the presentation....but with multiple people speaking. If, during practice that doesn't work for you, it is totally fine to 2) end your time speaking saying "and now I'll pass it off to [person's name] to talk about [topic]."
:::
